name: Big Lagoon State Park
description: Big Lagoon State Park beckons visitors to enjoy the Real Florida with opportunities to picnic, hike, camp, swim, fish, boat, kayak, standup paddleboard and canoe. Natural communities, ranging from saltwater tidal marshes to pine flatwoods, attract a wide variety of birds, especially during the spring and fall migrations. The park offers swimming, boating, fishing, camping, hiking and paddling. Adventurers can begin or end a 1,515-mile sea kayaking journey on the Florida Circumnavigational Saltwater Paddling Trail around the entire state. The park is a gateway for the Great Florida Birding and Wildlife Trail, serving as a stopover for more than 23 species of wood-warblers and a variety of ducks, sandpipers and black-bellied plovers. A three-story observation tower provides a bird's-eye view of the park's marshes and coastal forests.
